descriptionChirho: Loud noise of a crowd, armies, or waters; tumult, uproar, din -- used of the roaring of seas (Ps 65:8), tumult of nations (Isa 17:12-13), noise of battle or destruction (Jer 25:31; 46:17; 48:45; 51:55), and general commotion (Isa 5:14; 13:4; 24:8; 25:5; 66:6; Hos 10:14; Amos 2:2).
Tumultuous destruction or ruin; contextual sense in Ps 40:3 (the 'pit of tumult/devastation'), where the roaring imagery shades into the result of destruction.
